name: Queen City Greens
notes: Small-scale urban farm startup with a view to grow and produce for downtown Denver's best restaurants, markets, and grocers, as well as offering direct sales to consumers at area farmer's markets and through a CSA delivery program.

name: Sprout City Farms
months_open: March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November
category: CSA Farm, Roadside Market, Agritourism, Sells to Schools
notes: Sprout City Farms is an urban agriculture nonprofit (founded 2010) with 2 community farms in Denver & Lakewood. Half of our harvest is dedicated to food access programs for low-income families. Educational/community programs include Intern/Apprenticeships, Volunteer Days, Workshops, Tours, Events, and more--see our website!

notes: Locally owned market prioritizing small farmers and producers.  Focus on local, sustainable, and/or artisanal products. Offerings include summer/fall CSA partnership, CO honey and seasonal produce, bulk refill soaps, groceries, prepared meals and gifts.

name: BlueTrane Heritage Farm
months_open: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
notes: We specialize in the preservation and promotion of the endangered heritage breeds and heirloom varieties. Our produce is pesticide, fungicide and herbicide free. All are naturally grown in a sustaining way consistent with organic principles.
